summary: Iteration 2: tested Crypto Explore, Coin detail, AI Chart Analyst and regressions. Backend: 36/36 new tests pass (auth guards, overview, search, news, detail, 6 history periods, coin news, holding in detail, candles for all 6 intervals, unsupported USDT 404, validation), plus 25/25 regression tests from iteration 1 (the chat test was skipped to save AI calls). Frontend: login lands on /home; overview cards, trending, gainers, losers, top-20 table and news all render; search works for eth/BTC/solana with logos and INR prices and opens the coin page; coin detail shows price, performance, stats, all 6 history periods, about/links and Google News items; AI research streamed fine (1 AI call); Add to portfolio from coin detail saves and the holding banner appears; the chart renders, all intervals load, indicator toggles add/remove RSI/MACD panes with no page errors; Analyze Chart streamed and showed a timestamp; a quick question got a follow-up answer (2 AI calls); changing the interval cleared the analysis without a new AI call; USDT shows a friendly error and Analyze is disabled; /dashboard redirects to /portfolio, which shows the overview plus holdings with working edit/delete; Health/Analyst/Risk/Goals/Settings load; the mobile bottom nav scrolls with all 8 items. Main problems: (1) BNB and XRP (top-5 coins) open no coin page from search while CoinGecko is rate-limited, (2) the Chart Analyst page scrolls sideways on mobile, (3) CoinPaprika's free-tier block (402) is cached as 'no data'.

critical.issue: Coin id mismatch between sources. Search uses CoinGecko ids (binancecoin, ripple, pepe), but the CoinPaprika fallback builds '{symbol}-{cg_id}', e.g. bnb-binancecoin or xrp-ripple, which return 404 on CoinPaprika (the real ids are bnb-binance-coin and xrp-xrp). So whenever CoinGecko is rate-limited, searching 'bnb' or 'xrp' shows a result with no price or logo, and selecting it gives 404 'Market data unavailable'. Also, when the overview comes from CoinPaprika, the top/trending ids are CoinPaprika ids (binance-coin, xrp). Adding a holding from those pages stores coin_id='binance-coin' instead of CoinGecko's 'binancecoin', so portfolio pricing and the 'You hold' banner will not match once CoinGecko is back. Fix: build a symbol/name-to-CoinPaprika-id map from the cached /v1/tickers list (or /v1/coins), and normalise all ids to CoinGecko ids (match by symbol + name from the CoinGecko search/markets list).

CoinPaprika returned HTTP 402 'request limits were reached… block_duration 1h' for every endpoint after about 50 per-coin requests during testing. _get only marks the host as failed on 429/5xx. For any other status (402 included) it overwrites the cache with None (line 54), which throws away the good stale data for the TTL. Fix: treat 402/403 like 429 (set _fail[host] with a longer backoff, ideally the block_duration) and never overwrite a valid cache entry with None. Also reduce per-coin CoinPaprika calls, for example by taking the ticker from the cached /v1/tickers list instead of /tickers/{id}.

minor.issue: circulating_supply shows 'Not available' for SOL and LINK; hashing_algorithm shows the literal string 'None' (LINK); social link names are shown raw ('Source_Code'); the description ends with 'Source: CoinPaprika.com'.

The clustering compares each value only to the previous one (groups[-1][-1]), so clusters chain and drift. BTC 1h gave a resistance with '49 touches' that spans a wide price range, which makes the AI's support/resistance claims misleading. Compare against the group mean instead and cap the group width.
The 'Trending' fallback (highest volume) is mostly stablecoins (Tether, USDC). Exclude stablecoins from it.

ui_bugs.issue: The page scrolls sideways: document scrollWidth is 563 vs a 390 viewport; the chart card is 521px and the AI panel 547px wide (x=-17). The grid track grows to the min-content of the unwrapped interval switch and the shrink-0 quick-question row. Fix: add grid-cols-1 to the grid at '<div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_400px] ...">' and min-w-0 to both grid children (k-card and ai-chart-panel).

Likely crash, found by reading the code (not reproduced, to save AI calls): changing the coin or interval while a stream is running resets msgs to [] via the useEffect, but the running stream's append() then does c[c.length-1].content on undefined and throws a TypeError inside the setState updater, which can crash the page. Fix: guard in append (if the list is empty, return it unchanged) and abort or ignore the stream with an AbortController or a run-id ref when coin or interval changes.

Race: on /login the initial /auth/me returns 401, then /auth/refresh is called. If the user logs in before that refresh returns (seen in automation), the late 401 logs the newly signed-in user out and sends them back to /login. Make the refresh-failure handler ignore responses that started before a successful login.

integration_issues.flow: Explore search -> coin detail (BNB/XRP/PEPE while CoinGecko is rate-limited)
integration_issues.issue: The result shows no price or logo, and selecting it goes to an error page (backend id-mismatch issue above).

issues: RSI/MACD pane axis labels have a ₹ prefix (e.g. '₹70', '₹51.4023') because the global priceFormatter is applied to every pane. Set priceFormat per series for the oscillators.
The '% in view' label uses the first of all 400 candles, not the visible range.
The USDT error reads "Couldn't load this data right now…" with a Retry button, although it is a permanent 'not supported' state.
The news column is much taller than the top-20 table, leaving a large empty area below the table.
Purchase date uses the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover.
Avg buy price is not prefilled with the current price when opened from coin detail.

action_items: Normalise coin ids to CoinGecko ids across Explore/search/detail/holdings, and map them to correct CoinPaprika ids (bnb-binance-coin, xrp-xrp) through a cached CoinPaprika coin list.
In market._get, treat 402 (and 403) as a host backoff and never overwrite a cached good value with None; cut per-coin CoinPaprika requests.
Fix the mobile horizontal overflow on /chart (grid-cols-1 + min-w-0 on the grid children).
Guard AIPanel append() against reset msgs and abort in-flight streams when coin or interval changes.
Use a non-₹ price format for the RSI and MACD panes.
Improve the support/resistance clustering in ta.levels (mean-based, bounded width).
Minor: exclude stablecoins from the trending fallback; fix 'None' and 'Source_Code' labels and missing circulating supply in the CoinPaprika detail; handle the auth refresh race after login.
critical_code_review_comments: explore.coin_detail fallback builds the CoinPaprika id as f'{symbol}-{cid}', which is only correct when CoinGecko and CoinPaprika slugs match (btc-bitcoin, eth-ethereum, sol-solana).

top_markets via CoinPaprika returns CoinPaprika-derived ids (binance-coin, xrp, wrapped-liquid-staked-ether-20), so ids switch with the data source and holdings created from Explore can be inconsistent.
market._get line 54 caches None on non-429 errors, so a temporary 402 erases stale fallback data.
CoinSearch has no request cancellation or ordering guard; a slow earlier response can overwrite newer results.
Research cache is keyed only by coin_id+day (fine), but explore.coin_detail + coin_news run again before every non-cached research call, adding more CoinPaprika load.

success_rate.backend: 100% of 36 new tests (61/61 incl. regression); 2 robustness bugs found by probing
success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows work; mobile chart overflow and BNB/XRP detail failures)

seed_data_creation: Test users test_<hex>@example.com were registered (one has an ETH holding). A Chainlink holding was added to admin through the UI, edited and then deleted, so admin holdings are back to BTC/ETH/SOL/DOGE. coin_research has a cached Chainlink summary for today.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI calls used this iteration: 3 (chainlink research, BTC 1h analysis, RSI quick question). Wait about 3s on /login before filling the form to avoid the auth-refresh race. Login testids: auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn. CoinPaprika blocked this server IP with 402 for 1h at about 17:06 UTC during testing, so expect fallback degradation if you hammer per-coin endpoints. By 17:13 CoinGecko was answering again (Explore source showed CoinGecko). Retest: search 'bnb'/'xrp' -> detail page (with CoinGecko down), /chart at 390px width (scrollWidth must equal 390), and switching interval during a streaming analysis.
rca of the issue: BNB/XRP detail 404: the backend log shows 'coinpaprika.com/v1/tickers/bnb-binancecoin -> 404' and 'xrp-ripple -> 404' because the CoinPaprika id is built from the CoinGecko id. Reproduce: GET /api/explore/search?q=bnb gives id 'binancecoin' with price null, then GET /api/coins/binancecoin/detail?symbol=bnb returns 404 while CoinGecko is 429. Mobile overflow: the implicit grid track at <lg is sized to the min-content of the non-wrapping flex rows; fixed with grid-cols-1/min-w-0.
